wa_mount_stickney_scramble.why: San Juan CG is 'the nearest developed camp to the Spire Mountain roadhead' on the Index-Galena road (North Fork Skykomish). Mount Stickney is approached from the Sultan Basin road/Olney Creek gate out of Sultan — a different drainage and road system across the divide. Copied from the Spire Mountain list (routesCarrying=3).

flags.camp: Bedal Basin, below the north side of Bedal Peak
flags.issue: The route's stated way in is the Merry Brook climbers' path (NW route) from the FR 4096 switchback at ~2,100 ft to the hidden ramp at ~5,100 ft (SummitPost/Mountaineers); Bedal Basin is reached by the Bedal Creek trail from the FR 4096 road end at ~2,800 ft below the north side. Possibly not on this route's line; not removed.

wa_bedal_peak_standard.why: Flag only; refused to remove — same peak, a single-route authored list, not a propagation.
